modules.title: Introduction to Social Justice and Equity
modules.html:
Fairness, accountability, the fight against corruption and the protection of the vulnerable. This section covers introduction to social justice and equity.

Key points

  • Which of the following is a core social value — Integrity.

Worked examples

Q: Which of the following is a core social value?
A: Integrity — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Integrity.

Q: The totality of the beliefs and ideas that a society or person considers important and useful is known as _____.
A: Values — Values represent the principles or standards of behavior; one's judgment of what is important in life. They are the shared beliefs of a society.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a core social value?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Integrity.

quiz.q: The totality of the beliefs and ideas that a society or person considers important and useful is known as _____.
quiz.solution: Values represent the principles or standards of behavior; one's judgment of what is important in life. They are the shared beliefs of a society.

quiz.q: Constitution is important because it...
options: Provides the framework for governance and protects rights
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Provides the framework for governance and protects rights.

quiz.q: The ability to depend on one's own efforts and abilities to satisfy needs is _____.
quiz.solution: Self-reliance is the quality of depending on yourself rather than on others for things. It is a key value in civic education aimed at reducing unemployment.

quiz.q: One of the major consequences of cultism on campus is _____.
quiz.solution: Students caught participating in cult activities face severe disciplinary actions, including expulsion or rustication from the university.

quiz.q: The green light on a traffic signal means _____.
quiz.solution: Standard international traffic light sequence: Red (Stop), Yellow/Amber (Ready/Caution), Green (Go).

quiz.q: The agency that fights against the distribution of fake and substandard drugs in Nigeria is _____.
quiz.solution: The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) regulates and controls the manufacture, importation, exportation, advertisement, distribution, sale and use of food, drugs, and chemicals.

quiz.q: A written constitution is a document that _____.
options: Is stored in the memory of the elders
Is found in a single legal document
Cannot be seen by the public
quiz.solution: A written constitution is a formal document defining the nature of the constitutional settlement, the rules that govern the political system, and the rights of citizens.

quiz.q: A major cause of voter apathy in Nigeria is _____.
quiz.solution: When elections are characterized by violence or the results are perceived as manipulated, citizens lose interest in voting.

quiz.q: The red light on a traffic signal indicates that the motorist should _____.
quiz.solution: Red always signifies 'Stop' in traffic regulations to prevent accidents.

quiz.q: An example of a drug that is frequently abused is _____.
quiz.solution: Cocaine is an illegal stimulant that is highly addictive and commonly abused, leading to severe health and social consequences.

quiz.q: A set of people who live together in a particular area and share common interests is a _____.
quiz.solution: A community is a group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common.

quiz.q: A major way of preventing the transmission of HIV/AIDS is _____.
quiz.solution: Abstinence from unprotected sexual intercourse is the most effective way to prevent the transmission of HIV.

quiz.q: The agency that fights against the distribution of fake drugs in Nigeria is _____.
quiz.solution: The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) regulates the quality of food, drugs, and chemicals.

quiz.q: Popular participation helps to _____.
quiz.solution: When many people participate in politics, they hold the government accountable, which leads to transparency and good governance.

quiz.q: In Nigeria, the President is elected for a term of _____ years.
quiz.solution: The 1999 Constitution provides for a four-year tenure for the President and Governors, renewable only once.

quiz.q: HIV transmission:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Unprotected sex.

quiz.q: Cultism causes:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Violence.

quiz.q: Discipline:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Self-control.

quiz.q: Constitution types:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Written/Unwritten.

quiz.q: The legislature at the state level is called:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: House of Assembly.

quiz.q: Which of the following causes road accidents?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Over-speeding.

quiz.q: The legislature in Nigeria is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Bicameral.

quiz.q: The Legislature:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Makes laws.

quiz.q: The 'Y' shape represents:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Rivers Niger and Benue.

quiz.q: Franchise is the right to:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Vote.

quiz.q: HIV/AIDS is primarily transmitted through...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Unprotected sexual intercourse.

quiz.q: Federalism is a system where power is shared between...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Central government and state governments.

quiz.q: The coat of arms of Nigeria has an eagle which represents:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Strength.

quiz.q: Freedom of the Press is essential for:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Democracy.

quiz.q: The head of the Judiciary is the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Chief Justice of Nigeria.

quiz.q: Constitutionalism:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Obeying constitution.

quiz.q: The EFCC investigates:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Financial crimes.

quiz.q: Self-reliance is promoted through:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Entrepreneurship/Skills.

quiz.q: Universal Adult Suffrage allows:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: All qualified adults to vote.
